name: CZ-1 (tutor droid)
description: CZ-1 was a tutor droid named after its model. It was owned by the Kyrell family, who resided on the planet Jelucan. Its primary function was to tutor Thane Kyrell as a child during the years after the Galactic Empire was formed. By this time, the droid was very old and would make a great deal of effort to move.
